measurement_provenance.selection: Single candidate and cosine floor 0.42 fixed before observing hybrid outcomes. Production qualification was not requested.

model.input: Unmodified BERT WordPiece tokenizer.json with special tokens, right batch padding, 512-token truncation, int64 input_ids/attention_mask/token_type_ids.
model.pooling: Mask-weighted FP32 mean of last_hidden_state over all nonpadding tokens, including specials, followed by L2 normalization.
model.language_coverage: Cached config and release manifest do not specify Korean training coverage.

runtime.model_warmup: One local, unscored synthetic input before binding the HTTP listener.
runtime.network: HTTP over IPv4 loopback; one local server, registry, and client with no proxy, API credentials, or upstream service.

provider_usage.query_tokenize_infer_pool_p95_method: Nearest-rank, uncached warm provider. Retrieval p95 including HTTP, ranking, selection and rendering is reported in modes.
